fall_height_m.notes: Table 1 of Kääb et al. (2021) gives a drop of 1.3 km for the 2018 glacier detachment, not for the 2017 rock avalanche; nothing was read for 2017.

fatalities.notes: No fatality count for the 2017 event was read in the retrieved text.

peak_velocity_ms.notes: No velocity for the 2017 avalanche was read.

rock_fraction.notes: Described as a rock avalanche that 'incorporated ice from the surface of the glaciers lower down'; no ratio stated.

runout_km.notes: The avalanche 'ran over large parts of the Sedongpu basin and down to Yarlung Tsangpo' (Kääb et al. 2021); no distance was read.

seismic.agency_range.notes: Only the Chinese catalogue magnitude (via Kääb et al. 2021) was read; no other agency magnitude.

source_elevation_m.notes: Kääb et al. (2021) give the Gyala Peri summit as 7294 m a.s.l. but do not state the elevation of the 2017 detachment zone on its north ridge.

name: Gyala Peri / Sedongpu rock–ice avalanche, October 2017, south-eastern Tibet
notes: Kääb et al. (2021): the avalanche dammed the Yarlung Tsangpo, drastically changed Sedongpu Glacier and was followed by debris flows into 2018 that preceded the October 2018 glacier detachment (sedongpu-2018-10). The 18 November 2017 M 6.9 Milin earthquake nearby 'may have contributed to the triggering of the debris flows'. dammed_river / secondary_surge are non-nullable booleans in the contract; where the retrieved sources do not state them they are recorded as false, meaning 'not established in the retrieved text', not 'established absent'.

magnitude.notes: 'a M 4.0 event at 06:22 directly at Sedongpu' in the Chinese seismic database, as reported by Kääb et al. (2021); magnitude type not stated

seismic.notes: A second 'landslide' signal (M 3.2 at 06:20 CST, about 16 km west of Sedongpu) is listed for the same morning; Kääb et al. (2021) confirm only the 06:22 signal as the Gyala Peri avalanche. Not in USGS ComCat as far as retrieved.

source_location.basis: Sedongpu Glacier location from Table 1 of Kääb et al. (2021); the 2017 avalanche 'started high up from the north ridge of Gyala Peri' above the basin, which was not located more precisely in the retrieved text

estimates.qualifier: DEM differencing: material removed from the first of 'two close-by but separated areas'
DEM differencing: material removed from the second area
'If both failures happened as part of the same event, the total volume of 50 × 10^6 m3'

source_volume_m3.notes: Kääb et al. (2021) cannot tell whether the two source areas failed in one event; low is the smaller single area, high the combined total

time.basis: Kääb et al. (2021): 'The Chinese seismic database registered ... a M 4.0 event at 06:22 (China standard time) [22 October 2017] directly at Sedongpu', which Chen et al.
